name: arr-01-ontario-place
js: (() => { const app = __CITY_APP, tg = app.tourGuide; const q = "Ontario Place"; const p = tg.search(q)[0]; if (p) { tg.teleportToPlace(p); tg.showPlace(p, { fly: false }); } const e = app.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(); console.log('[ride-check] arrival ' + q + ' -> ' + (p ? p.kind + ': ' + p.name + ' @' + Math.round(p.x) + ',' + Math.round(p.z) : 'nothing') + ' | player ' + Math.round(e.position.x) + ',' + Math.round(e.position.z) + ' | ' + window.CITY.getLocationLabel(e.position.x, e.position.z)); })()
